observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for a GLAMSTAR 18-inch rechargeable floor fan.
The model number GSF-938R-B is clearly printed on the box.
The box is wrapped in a thin plastic film.
The actual fan is not visible in the photo; only the box is shown.
The background appears to be an outdoor market or street setting.

claims.evidence: The box claims 'High Speed' but the fan's performance is not shown.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, lower-value item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual fan outside of the box.

risks.risk: The internal rechargeable battery may be dead or have significantly degraded capacity.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan running on battery power alone for several minutes.
risks.if_unproven: priced as requiring a battery replacement

risks.risk: The fan motor, charging circuit, or remote control may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video demonstrating the fan spinning at all speeds and the charging indicator working.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual fan out of the box.
Video of the fan running on battery power.
Photo of the charging cable and remote control.
response.reason: Only the retail box is shown. Without seeing the actual fan, its presence, condition, and functionality cannot be verified, making even a worst-case valuation of the fan itself speculative.
